site.name: Congo Chief Mine
overview: Congo Chief Mine is a named historic silver mine in Boulder County's Caribou mining area, northeast of Nederland.

The mine is preserved on U.S. Geological Survey topographic mapping. Federal securities records identify the Congo Chief lode as patented Survey No. 20305 and document a 2005 purchase of the mine property.

timeline.text: The Congo Chief lode became a patented mining property recorded as Boulder County Survey No. 20305.
A public company filing recorded the purchase of the Congo Chief Mine and surrounding property from the estate of Jack Snyder for $280,000.

moreHistory: The patented Congo Chief lode contains approximately 20.66 acres and lies within portions of Sections 4 and 5, Township 1 South, Range 73 West of the Sixth Principal Meridian.

The mapped mine locality at approximately 39.99304, -105.57667 provides a defensible historic mine-level identification point. It does not confirm the position or condition of a surviving portal, shaft collar, or other working.
Mining property and access conditions can change. Remain on lawful public routes, respect private property and closures, and never enter abandoned workings.
